description: Defines the 'Value' class representing variable values in an interpreter, including types, constructors, accessors, and comparison operators.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a variable value with multiple types (NONE, BOOLEAN, INTEGER, STRING, LIST, SCOPE) and associated methods.

methods.description: Constructor with origin and boolean value.
